As he read the faint words of greeting from a long-lost friend, Thomas smiled, feeling the warmth of a forgotten memory pierce through the heavy ocean fog.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还在沉睡，路灯拉长了空旷街道上的影子。偶尔有环卫工人的扫帚声划破寂静，沙沙作响，伴随着远处微弱的车轮声。空气里带着夜露的凉意，高楼的窗户大多漆黑，只有几盏夜班灯火在夜色中静静闪烁。整个世界仿佛放慢了呼吸，等待着第一缕晨光的唤醒，孕育着新一天的生机与故事。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a function calls itself to solve a smaller piece of the same problem.\n- It always needs a stopping condition, called the base case, so it does not run forever.\n- Think of it like opening a box inside a box until you finally find the tiniest empty box at the very bottom."}
